ja397:1.1: Yathā cāpo ninnamati jiyā cāpi nikūjati haññate nūna Manojo migarājā sakhā mama.
ja397:2.1: Handa dāni vanantāni pakkamāmi yathāsukhaṃ, n' etādisā sakhā honti, labbhā me jīvato sakhā ti.
ja397:3.1: Na pāpajanasaṃsevī accantasukham edhati, Manojaṃ passa semānaṃ, Giriyassānusāsanī.
ja397:4.1: Na pāpasampavaṃkena mātā puttena nandati, Manojaṃ passa semānaṃ acchannaṃ samhi lohite.
ja397:5.1: Evam āpajjatī poso pāpiyo ca nigacchati yo ve hitānaṃ vacanaṃ na karoti atthadassinaṃ.
ja397:6.1: Evañ ca so hoti tato va pāpiyo yo uttamo adhamajanūpasevī, pass' uttamaṃ adhamajanūpasevitaṃ migādhipaṃ saravaravedhanibbutan ti.
ja397:7.1: {Nihīyati} puriso nihīnasevī, na ca hāyetha kadāci tulyasevī, seṭṭham upanamaṃ udeti khippaṃ, tasmā attano uttariṃ bhajethā 'ti.
